Agent.title: Agent
Agent.body:
Here you keep watch over the agent. Read the conversation to see what it did and why, then work through the proposals.

The agent records each write as a proposal instead of posting it; you approve or reject every one. Under Trust you set how far each kind of action is trusted, from always ask to run automatically.

That grant is yours alone to give: no agent can raise its own trust.

consequence.post: Posts irreversibly to the journal. The only correction is a reversing entry.
consequence.issue: Issues the document for good. Issued means immutable.
consequence.send: Sends outward. Sent cannot be recalled.
consequence.dun: Triggers the reminder run and raises the debtors' dunning level.
consequence.pay: Books a payment and settles open items.
consequence.vat-file: Marks the VAT period as filed. A filed period is closed.
consequence.customize: Changes the record structure for the whole workspace.
consequence.plugin-install: Installs third-party code with the granted scopes.
consequence.close-period: Seals an accounting period against further posting. A hard seal cannot be reopened.
consequence.go-live: Commits migration data into the live books. The cutover cannot be undone.

consequenceVerb.close_year: After this you can no longer post anything in this fiscal year and nothing can be undone. There is no way back.
consequenceVerb.invite_member: Seats a person or an agent in the workspace with the chosen role. Whoever redeems the token sees the books from then on.
consequenceVerb.set_role: Changes what a member may see and do here. The new rights apply on their next call.
consequenceVerb.revoke_member: Removes a member's access to the workspace. The lockout applies on their next call.
consequenceVerb.define_role: Redefines which rights a role holds, for everyone who has that role.
